page.overview:
What is Akanal?

The Akanal, also known as the Akanul and the Akanul Plains, was a stretch of land in southwestern Chessenta, famed as being among the most fertile farmland anywhere in the Realms.

The Akanal comprised the peninsula between the Akanamere's western and southern arms and the lands around the lake's southern shore. The east and south were bordered by the Hills of Maerth.

Circa 1357 DR, the settlements of the Akanal paid tribute to the city-state of Akanax on a regular basis.

The Akanal boasted incredibly fertile and productive farmland, and was the best in Chessenta and the Old Empires and among the finest in all of Faerûn. The lands around the Akanamere were planted with cash crops in large plantations. Their produce was shipped to Akanax and Soorenar, and from there to Airspur, Cimbar, and Reth, and all in all provided more than half of Chessenta's food supply.
